                    阅读9分钟
                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-61fb5e44=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body cache result"><p>在 AI 辅助开发逐渐成为日常的今天，一套脚手架不仅要减少重复工作，也要让 AI 看懂项目结构、遵循开发规范，并在明确的架构边界内完成开发。</p>
<p>此前已经分享过鸿蒙和安卓版本的快速开发框架，这次继续带来 Flutter 版本。FlutterKit 基于 Flutter + Dart + GetX + TDesign Flutter，内置网络、分页、数据库、状态管理、导航、屏幕适配等常用能力，支持深色模式、国际化和多端适配，欢迎一起学习交流。</p>
<p>项目同时提供项目级 <code>AGENTS.md</code> 和覆盖 UI、数据、导航、主题、预览等场景的专项 Skill，帮助 AI 参与功能开发、代码重构、单元测试和文档维护。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-0">项目亮点</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>开箱即用</strong>：内置网络、分页、数据库、状态管理等基础能力，无需重复搭建</li>
<li><strong>完整示例</strong>：每个功能模块都提供可运行的 Demo 页面，方便直接查看效果和代码</li>
<li><strong>质量保障</strong>：Core 与 Demo 均配套单元测试，行覆盖率不低于 98%，分支覆盖率不低于 95%</li>
<li><strong>模块化架构</strong>：使用 bootstrap、core、routes、feature 划分职责，业务模块之间保持隔离</li>
<li><strong>现代化技术栈</strong>：Flutter + Dart + GetX + TDesign Flutter，支持 Android、iOS、Web 和桌面端</li>
<li><strong>屏幕适配</strong>：支持手机、折叠屏、平板以及横竖屏布局切换</li>
<li><strong>深色模式</strong>：支持浅色、深色和跟随系统，并持久化用户选择</li>
<li><strong>国际化支持</strong>：内置中英文语言切换，Core 与 Feature 文案分模块维护</li>
<li><strong>在线文档</strong>：框架文档与代码同步维护，方便学习、查阅和二次开发</li>
<li><strong>AI 辅助开发</strong>：提供项目级 <code>AGENTS.md</code> 和专项 Skill，帮助 AI 工具理解框架边界</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>如果项目对你有帮助，请给个 Star 支持 ⭐ 这对我来说很重要，能给我带来长期更新维护的动力！</p>
</blockquote>

<h2 data-id="heading-1">项目预览</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>💡 <strong>说明</strong>：框架提供了多种示例页面，展示网络、分页、数据库、主题、导航、状态管理等能力，支持手机、折叠屏和平板等设备形态。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">📱 手机</h3>

<h3 data-id="heading-3">📱 平板</h3>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/7fbf1abf55a44b0db54c52855d1f159d~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgSm9rZXJY:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1786282533&amp;x-signature=GKsj8yM8HZQJz8YSMwLQ9z4mH6E%3D" alt="tablet.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-id="heading-4">架构设计</h2>
<p>FlutterKit 采用模块化分层架构，从上到下分为业务层、核心层和入口层：</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-5">业务层（Feature）</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>功能模块</strong>：按业务域拆分，目前包含认证、用户、主页和 Demo 等模块</li>
<li><strong>页面分层</strong>：使用 View + Logic + State + Binding 组织页面代码</li>
<li><strong>模块组件</strong>：单模块复用的 Widget、数据和服务保留在 Feature 内</li>
<li><strong>国际化资源</strong>：每个 Feature 单独维护文案 Key 和中英文翻译</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-6">核心层（Core）</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>base</strong>：基础父类与页面状态封装（BaseLogic、BaseNetworkLogic、BaseListLogic、BaseRefreshLogic、BaseTabLogic）</li>
<li><strong>data</strong>：统一数据入口，保存 Repository 与静态 Preview Data</li>
<li><strong>database</strong>：基于 sqflite 的本地数据库能力</li>
<li><strong>datastore</strong>：基于 shared_preferences 的轻量级本地存储</li>
<li><strong>design_system</strong>：主题、颜色、间距、字体、形状、阴影和 Widget 链式扩展</li>
<li><strong>localization</strong>：Core 公共文案与翻译聚合</li>
<li><strong>model</strong>：请求模型、响应模型、分页模型和业务实体</li>
<li><strong>network</strong>：Dio、Retrofit、拦截器、DataSource 和 Debug 网络面板</li>
<li><strong>result</strong>：RequestHelper、统一错误格式化和请求结果处理</li>
<li><strong>service</strong>：用户状态、登录状态和跨页面共享 Service</li>
<li><strong>ui</strong>：通用 UI 组件、响应式断点和 Widget Preview</li>
<li><strong>util</strong>：Storage、Route、Toast、Alert、Size、Common 等工具</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-7">入口层（Application）</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>应用入口</strong>：负责 Flutter 应用启动与 <code>GetMaterialApp</code> 构建</li>
<li><strong>启动初始化</strong>：统一初始化存储、主题、语言、Service 和网络调试工具</li>
<li><strong>路由注册</strong>：汇总各模块 GetPage、Binding、参数、结果和路由守卫</li>
<li><strong>多端配置</strong>：维护 Android、iOS、Web、macOS、Linux、Windows 原生工程</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-8">依赖关系</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>feature 依赖 core</strong>：业务模块可以使用 Core 提供的公共能力</li>
<li><strong>feature 不直接依赖 network / database</strong>：业务模块通过 Repository 访问底层数据</li>
<li><strong>routes 负责模块跳转</strong>：Feature 之间不直接 import 对方的页面实现</li>
<li><strong>core 不依赖 feature</strong>：公共能力不能反向引用具体业务模块</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/ff34af6be7484d36a148c09a1cff869e~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgSm9rZXJY:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1786282533&amp;x-signature=GUJmUnZLs2qC6g6BAwfdQME4nog%3D" alt="architecture.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-id="heading-9">技术栈</h2>













































<table><thead><tr><th>类别</th><th>技术选型</th><th>说明</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>编程语言</td><td>Dart</td><td>Flutter 官方开发语言</td></tr><tr><td>UI 框架</td><td>Flutter + TDesign Flutter</td><td>跨平台 UI 与业务组件</td></tr><tr><td>架构模式</td><td>View + Logic + State + Binding</td><td>页面分层与依赖注册</td></tr><tr><td>状态与导航</td><td>GetX</td><td>Rx、Obx、GetPage、Binding、Service</td></tr><tr><td>网络请求</td><td>Dio + Retrofit</td><td>HTTP 客户端、拦截器和接口声明</td></tr><tr><td>数据存储</td><td>sqflite + shared_preferences</td><td>数据库与轻量级本地存储</td></tr><tr><td>屏幕适配</td><td>flutter_screenutil + BreakpointType</td><td>尺寸适配与响应式断点</td></tr></tbody></table>
<h2 data-id="heading-10">核心能力</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-11">1. 网络请求封装</h3>
<p>基于 Dio + Retrofit 的网络请求封装，采用 <strong>DataSource → Repository → Logic</strong> 三层架构，框架统一处理错误、loading、toast、dialog 和页面状态。</p>
<p><strong>功能特性：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>统一管理 Dio 实例、baseUrl、timeout 和 headers</li>
<li>使用 Retrofit 声明类型安全的网络 DataSource</li>
<li>自动处理 HTTP 状态码与业务错误码</li>
<li>支持 RequestHelper 链式配置 loading、toast、dialog 和错误回调</li>
<li>支持 BaseNetwork 自动管理加载、错误、空数据和成功状态</li>
<li>Debug 模式提供 Alice 网络请求面板和 PrettyDioLogger 日志</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>使用案例：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-dart" lang="dart"><span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">请求商品详情。</span></span>
Future&lt;<span class="hljs-keyword">void</span>&gt; requestGoodsDetail() {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> RequestHelper.repository&lt;Goods&gt;(
    GoodsRepository().getGoodsInfo(<span class="hljs-number">1</span>),
  )
      .loading(<span class="hljs-keyword">true</span>) <span class="hljs-comment">// 请求过程显示 Loading。</span>
      .toast(<span class="hljs-keyword">true</span>) <span class="hljs-comment">// 业务失败自动显示 Toast。</span>
      .execute()
      .then&lt;<span class="hljs-keyword">void</span>&gt;((Goods? goods) {
        LogUtil.d(<span class="hljs-string">'商品详情：<span class="hljs-subst">${goods?.title}</span>'</span>);
      })
      .catchError((<span class="hljs-built_in">Object</span> error) {
        LogUtil.e(error.toString());
      });
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>单次请求场景（自动处理加载、错误、空数据和成功状态）：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-dart" lang="dart"><span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">网络请求示例页 State。</span></span>
<span class="hljs-class"><span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title">NetworkDemoState</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">extends</span> <span class="hljs-title">BaseNetworkState</span> </span>{
  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">商品详情。</span></span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> Rx&lt;Goods&gt; goods = Goods().obs;
}

<span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">网络请求示例页 Logic。</span></span>
<span class="hljs-class"><span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title">NetworkDemoLogic</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">extends</span> <span class="hljs-title">BaseNetworkLogic</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-title">Goods</span>&gt; </span>{
  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">页面展示状态。</span></span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> NetworkDemoState networkDemoState = NetworkDemoState();

  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">商品仓库。</span></span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> GoodsRepository _goodsRepository = GoodsRepository();

  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">网络父类复用页面声明的 State。</span></span>
  <span class="hljs-meta">@override</span>
  NetworkDemoState <span class="hljs-keyword">get</span> networkState =&gt; networkDemoState;

  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">商品详情请求。</span></span>
  <span class="hljs-meta">@override</span>
  Future&lt;BaseResponse&lt;Goods&gt;&gt; <span class="hljs-built_in">Function</span>()? <span class="hljs-keyword">get</span> apiRequest =&gt;
      () =&gt; _goodsRepository.getGoodsInfo(<span class="hljs-number">1</span>);

  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">保存商品详情。</span></span>
  <span class="hljs-meta">@override</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">void</span> requestOk(Goods data) =&gt; networkDemoState.goods.value = data;
}
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-dart" lang="dart"><span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">网络请求示例页。</span></span>
<span class="hljs-class"><span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title">NetworkDemoView</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">extends</span> <span class="hljs-title">BaseNetworkView</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-title">NetworkDemoLogic</span>&gt; </span>{
  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">创建网络请求示例页。</span></span>
  NetworkDemoView({<span class="hljs-keyword">super</span>.key, <span class="hljs-keyword">super</span>.logic});

  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">构建请求成功后的页面内容。</span></span>
  <span class="hljs-meta">@override</span>
  Widget bodyContent(NetworkDemoLogic logic) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> Obx(
      () =&gt; GoodsDetailContent(
        goods: logic.networkDemoState.goods.value,
      ),
    );
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p><code>BaseNetworkLogic</code> 会调用 <code>apiRequest</code>，请求成功后执行 <code>requestOk()</code>；<code>BaseNetworkView</code> 根据当前状态展示 Loading、错误页、空页面或业务内容。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>具体实现代码，请参考：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fflutter.dusksnow.top%2Fhelp%2Fcore%2Fnetwork.html" target="_blank" title="https://flutter.dusksnow.top/help/core/network.html" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">网络请求文档</a> | <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fflutter.dusksnow.top%2Fhelp%2Fcore%2Fresult.html" target="_blank" title="https://flutter.dusksnow.top/help/core/result.html" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">结果处理文档</a></p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-id="heading-12">2. 分页列表封装</h3>
<p>统一封装分页列表的首次加载、下拉刷新、上拉加载、空态、错误处理和无更多数据，开发者只需关心请求参数与列表项渲染。</p>
<p><strong>功能特性：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>自动处理加载中、成功、失败和空数据四种状态</li>
<li>自动处理下拉刷新与上拉加载更多</li>
<li>自动管理 <code>currentPage</code>、<code>pageSize</code> 和分页请求参数</li>
<li>自动判断是否还有更多数据</li>
<li>加载更多失败后自动恢复到上一成功页</li>
<li>下一页返回空列表时保留已有内容并标记无更多数据</li>
<li>支持自定义加载、错误、空态和列表项 Widget</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Logic 实现：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-dart" lang="dart"><span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">网络列表示例页 State。</span></span>
<span class="hljs-class"><span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title">NetworkListDemoState</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">extends</span> <span class="hljs-title">BaseListState</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-title">Goods</span>&gt; </span>{
  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">单页商品数量。</span></span>
  <span class="hljs-meta">@override</span>
  <span class="hljs-built_in">int</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">get</span> pageSize =&gt; <span class="hljs-number">15</span>;
}

<span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">网络列表示例页 Logic。</span></span>
<span class="hljs-class"><span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title">NetworkListDemoLogic</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">extends</span> <span class="hljs-title">BaseListLogic</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-title">Goods</span>&gt; </span>{
  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">创建网络列表示例页 Logic。</span></span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">///</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">[goodsRepository] 可选商品仓库，测试和预览可注入 Fake 实现。</span></span>
  NetworkListDemoLogic({GoodsRepository? goodsRepository})
      : _goodsRepository = goodsRepository ?? GoodsRepository();

  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">页面分页状态。</span></span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> NetworkListDemoState networkListDemoState = NetworkListDemoState();

  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">分页父类复用页面声明的 State。</span></span>
  <span class="hljs-meta">@override</span>
  NetworkListDemoState <span class="hljs-keyword">get</span> listState =&gt; networkListDemoState;

  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">商品仓库。</span></span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> GoodsRepository _goodsRepository;

  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">商品分页请求。</span></span>
  <span class="hljs-meta">@override</span>
  Future&lt;BaseResponse&lt;BaseListResponse&lt;Goods&gt;&gt;&gt; <span class="hljs-built_in">Function</span>()? <span class="hljs-keyword">get</span> apiRequest {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> () =&gt; _goodsRepository.getGoodsPage(
      GoodsSearchRequest(
        page: listState.currentPage,
        size: listState.pageSize,
      ),
    );
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>页面使用：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-dart" lang="dart"><span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">网络列表示例页。</span></span>
<span class="hljs-class"><span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title">NetworkListDemoView</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">extends</span> <span class="hljs-title">BaseListView</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-title">NetworkListDemoLogic</span>, <span class="hljs-title">Goods</span>&gt; </span>{
  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">创建网络列表示例页。</span></span>
  NetworkListDemoView({<span class="hljs-keyword">super</span>.key, <span class="hljs-keyword">super</span>.logic});

  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">构建商品列表项。</span></span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">///</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">[item] 当前商品。</span></span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">[index] 当前索引。</span></span>
  <span class="hljs-meta">@override</span>
  Widget itemWidget(Goods item, <span class="hljs-built_in">int</span> index) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> GoodsListCard(goods: item);
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>使用步骤：</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>State 继承 <code>BaseListState&lt;T&gt;</code>，按需重写 <code>pageSize</code></li>
<li>Logic 继承 <code>BaseListLogic&lt;T&gt;</code> 并实现 <code>apiRequest</code></li>
<li>View 继承 <code>BaseListView&lt;Logic, T&gt;</code> 并实现 <code>itemWidget</code></li>
<li>父类统一管理 EasyRefresh、页码、列表状态和无更多数据</li>
</ol>
<blockquote>
<p>具体实现代码，请参考：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fflutter.dusksnow.top%2Fhelp%2Fcore%2Fbase-list.html" target="_blank" title="https://flutter.dusksnow.top/help/core/base-list.html" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">分页列表文档</a></p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-id="heading-13">3. 状态管理</h3>
<p>基于 GetX 的 Rx、Obx 和 GetxService 实现页面状态与全局状态共享。</p>
<p><strong>功能特性：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>类型安全的响应式状态定义</li>
<li><code>Obx</code> 自动监听 Rx 变化并更新 Widget</li>
<li>页面状态由 Feature State 管理</li>
<li>跨页面状态使用 GetxService 管理</li>
<li>主题、语言和用户状态支持持久化恢复</li>
<li>Binding 统一注册页面 Logic，避免在 View 中创建控制器</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>状态定义：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-dart" lang="dart"><span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">Demo 计数器服务。</span></span>
<span class="hljs-class"><span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title">DemoCounterService</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">extends</span> <span class="hljs-title">GetxService</span> </span>{
  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">当前计数值。</span></span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> RxInt count = <span class="hljs-number">0.</span>obs;

  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">计数值加一。</span></span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">void</span> increase() {
    count.value += <span class="hljs-number">1</span>;
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>使用案例：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-dart" lang="dart"><span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">构建状态管理示例。</span></span>
Widget buildCounter() {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> DemoCounterService service = Get.find&lt;DemoCounterService&gt;();

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> Obx(() {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> Column(
      children: &lt;Widget&gt;[
        TDText(<span class="hljs-string">'当前计数：<span class="hljs-subst">${service.count.value}</span>'</span>),
        TDButton(text: <span class="hljs-string">'增加'</span>, onTap: service.increase),
      ],
    );
  });
}
</code></pre>
<p>页面临时状态放在 State，跨页面状态放在 Service，主题和语言等应用级状态放在 <code>Application</code>。不建议把所有 Rx 都放进全局 Service。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>具体实现代码，请参考：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fflutter.dusksnow.top%2Fhelp%2Fcore%2Fstate.html" target="_blank" title="https://flutter.dusksnow.top/help/core/state.html" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">状态管理文档</a></p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-id="heading-14">4. 导航管理</h3>
<p>统一管理路由注册、页面跳转、参数传递、结果回传和登录拦截。</p>
<p><strong>功能特性：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>类型安全的路由参数与返回结果</li>
<li>模块化路由注册（Routes + Pages）</li>
<li>统一模块 Navigator</li>
<li>支持带参跳转与结果回传</li>
<li>支持登录拦截与 GetMiddleware 路由守卫</li>
<li>Android 使用平台原生转场并支持预测性返回</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>路由定义：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-dart" lang="dart"><span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">Demo 模块路由。</span></span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">abstract</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> <span class="hljs-class"><span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title">DemoRoutes</span> </span>{
  <span class="hljs-keyword">static</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">String</span> navigationWithArgs = <span class="hljs-string">'/demo/navigation-with-args'</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">static</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">String</span> navigationResult = <span class="hljs-string">'/demo/navigation-result'</span>;
}

<span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">Demo 模块导航参数。</span></span>
<span class="hljs-class"><span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title">DemoParams</span> </span>{
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> DemoParams({<span class="hljs-keyword">required</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">this</span>.goodsId});
  <span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">int</span> goodsId;
}

<span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">Demo 模块导航结果。</span></span>
<span class="hljs-class"><span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title">DemoResult</span> </span>{
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> DemoResult({<span class="hljs-keyword">required</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">this</span>.id, <span class="hljs-keyword">required</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">this</span>.message});
  <span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">int</span> id;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">String</span> message;
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>Navigator 封装（推荐）：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-dart" lang="dart"><span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">Demo 模块导航器。</span></span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">abstract</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> <span class="hljs-class"><span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title">DemoNavigator</span> </span>{
  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">跳转到带参导航示例页。</span></span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">static</span> Future&lt;T?&gt;? toNavigationWithArgs&lt;T&gt;(<span class="hljs-built_in">int</span> goodsId) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> toPage&lt;T&gt;(
      DemoRoutes.navigationWithArgs,
      arguments: DemoParams(goodsId: goodsId),
    );
  }

  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">跳转到结果回传示例页。</span></span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">static</span> Future&lt;DemoResult?&gt;? toNavigationResult() {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> toPage&lt;DemoResult&gt;(DemoRoutes.navigationResult);
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>使用案例：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-dart" lang="dart"><span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">打开带参页面。</span></span>
Future&lt;<span class="hljs-keyword">void</span>&gt; openGoodsPage() <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> DemoNavigator.toNavigationWithArgs&lt;<span class="hljs-keyword">void</span>&gt;(<span class="hljs-number">10086</span>);
}

<span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">打开结果回传页面。</span></span>
Future&lt;<span class="hljs-keyword">void</span>&gt; openResultPage() <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> DemoResult? result = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> DemoNavigator.toNavigationResult();
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (result != <span class="hljs-keyword">null</span>) {
    ToastUtil.success(result.message);
  }
}
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="hljs language-dart" lang="dart"><span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">读取当前页面参数。</span></span>
<span class="hljs-class"><span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title">NavigationWithArgsLogic</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">extends</span> <span class="hljs-title">BaseLogic</span> </span>{
  <span class="hljs-keyword">late</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> DemoParams params = args <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> DemoParams;
}

<span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">返回页面结果。</span></span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">void</span> submitResult() {
  back&lt;DemoResult&gt;(<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> DemoResult(id: <span class="hljs-number">1</span>, message: <span class="hljs-string">'操作成功'</span>));
}
</code></pre>
<p>应用根节点使用 <code>Transition.native</code>，Android Manifest 显式开启 <code>android:enableOnBackInvokedCallback="true"</code>，让 Android 14 及以上页面接入预测性返回。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>具体实现代码，请参考：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fflutter.dusksnow.top%2Fhelp%2Fnavigation%2F" target="_blank" title="https://flutter.dusksnow.top/help/navigation/" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">导航管理文档</a></p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-id="heading-15">5. 屏幕适配</h3>
<p>完整的屏幕适配方案，支持手机、折叠屏、平板以及横竖屏布局。</p>
<p><strong>功能特性：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>XS / SM / MD / LG 四档响应式断点</li>
<li><code>BuildContext.bp()</code> 响应式取值</li>
<li><code>BreakpointType.bp()</code> 支持 LayoutBuilder 局部约束</li>
<li>flutter_screenutil 提供基础尺寸适配</li>
<li>SafeArea 与 MediaQuery 处理刘海、挖孔和手势区域</li>
<li>主页面根据横竖屏切换底部导航和左侧导航</li>
<li>Widget Preview 同时检查多种设备尺寸</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>断点规则：</strong></p>






























<table><thead><tr><th>断点</th><th>说明</th><th>宽度范围（dp）</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code>XS</code></td><td>超小屏</td><td><code>&lt; 320</code></td></tr><tr><td><code>SM</code></td><td>小屏</td><td><code>320 - 599</code></td></tr><tr><td><code>MD</code></td><td>中屏</td><td><code>600 - 839</code></td></tr><tr><td><code>LG</code></td><td>大屏</td><td><code>&gt;= 840</code></td></tr></tbody></table>
<p><strong>网格布局适配：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-dart" lang="dart"><span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">构建响应式商品网格。</span></span>
Widget buildGoodsGrid(BuildContext context, <span class="hljs-built_in">List</span>&lt;Goods&gt; goods) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">int</span> columns = context.bp&lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">int</span>&gt;(xs: <span class="hljs-number">2</span>, sm: <span class="hljs-number">2</span>, md: <span class="hljs-number">3</span>, lg: <span class="hljs-number">4</span>);

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> GridView.builder(
    gridDelegate: SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
      crossAxisCount: columns,
      crossAxisSpacing: <span class="hljs-number">12</span>,
      mainAxisSpacing: <span class="hljs-number">12</span>,
    ),
    itemCount: goods.length,
    itemBuilder: (BuildContext context, <span class="hljs-built_in">int</span> index) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> GoodsListCard(goods: goods[index]);
    },
  );
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>文本适配：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-dart" lang="dart"><span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">构建响应式文本。</span></span>
Widget buildAdaptiveText(BuildContext context) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">double</span> fontSize = context.bp&lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">double</span>&gt;(
    xs: <span class="hljs-number">14</span>,
    sm: <span class="hljs-number">14</span>,
    md: <span class="hljs-number">16</span>,
    lg: <span class="hljs-number">22</span>,
  );

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> Text(
    <span class="hljs-string">'大屏适配示例文字'</span>,
    style: TextStyle(fontSize: fontSize),
  );
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>导航栏位置调整：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-dart" lang="dart"><span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">根据屏幕方向切换导航位置。</span></span>
Widget buildMainLayout(
  BuildContext context,
  Widget page,
  Widget sideNavigation,
) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">bool</span> isLandscape =
      MediaQuery.orientationOf(context) == Orientation.landscape;

  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (isLandscape) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> Row(
      children: &lt;Widget&gt;[
        sideNavigation,
        Expanded(child: page),
      ],
    );
  }

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> page;
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>安全区适配：</strong></p>
<p>普通页面顶部通过 <code>BaseView.head()</code> 的 AppBar 避开状态栏；底部操作区使用 <code>SafeArea(top: false)</code> 避开系统手势区域。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-dart" lang="dart"><span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">构建页面底部操作按钮。</span></span>
<span class="hljs-comment">///</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">[onSubmit] 提交回调。</span></span>
Widget buildBottomAction(VoidCallback onSubmit) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> SafeArea(
    top: <span class="hljs-keyword">false</span>,
    child: TDButton(text: <span class="hljs-string">'提交'</span>, onTap: onSubmit),
  );
}
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>具体实现代码，请参考：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fflutter.dusksnow.top%2Fhelp%2Fexpand%2Fscreen-adapt.html" target="_blank" title="https://flutter.dusksnow.top/help/expand/screen-adapt.html" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">屏幕适配文档</a> | <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fflutter.dusksnow.top%2Fhelp%2Fexpand%2Fsafe-area.html" target="_blank" title="https://flutter.dusksnow.top/help/expand/safe-area.html" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">安全区文档</a></p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-id="heading-16">6. 数据库封装</h3>
<p>基于 sqflite 的本地数据库能力，采用 <strong>DataSource → Repository</strong> 架构，业务层通过 Repository 访问数据库。</p>
<p><strong>实体定义（简化示例）：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-dart" lang="dart"><span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">Demo 表实体。</span></span>
<span class="hljs-class"><span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title">DemoEntity</span> </span>{
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> DemoEntity({
    <span class="hljs-keyword">this</span>.id,
    <span class="hljs-keyword">this</span>.title = <span class="hljs-string">''</span>,
    <span class="hljs-keyword">this</span>.description,
  });

  <span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">int?</span> id;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">String</span> title;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">String?</span> description;

  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">转换为数据库字段 Map。</span></span>
  <span class="hljs-built_in">Map</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">String</span>, <span class="hljs-built_in">dynamic</span>&gt; toMap({<span class="hljs-built_in">bool</span> includeId = <span class="hljs-keyword">true</span>}) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> &lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">String</span>, <span class="hljs-built_in">dynamic</span>&gt;{
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (includeId) <span class="hljs-string">'id'</span>: id,
      <span class="hljs-string">'title'</span>: title,
      <span class="hljs-string">'description'</span>: description,
    };
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>使用案例：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-dart" lang="dart"><span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">数据库示例页 Logic。</span></span>
<span class="hljs-class"><span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title">DatabaseDemoLogic</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">extends</span> <span class="hljs-title">BaseLogic</span> </span>{
  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">Demo 数据仓库。</span></span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> DemoRepository _demoRepository = DemoRepository();

  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">Demo 记录列表。</span></span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> RxList&lt;DemoEntity&gt; items = &lt;DemoEntity&gt;[].obs;

  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">保存记录。</span></span>
  Future&lt;<span class="hljs-keyword">void</span>&gt; save() <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> _demoRepository.createDemo(<span class="hljs-string">'示例标题'</span>, description: <span class="hljs-string">'示例描述'</span>);
    items.value = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> _demoRepository.getAll();
  }

}
</code></pre>
<p><code>DatabaseProvider</code> 统一管理数据库连接、并发首次打开、建表和关闭。DataSource 负责 SQL、表名和字段映射，Feature 不直接持有 <code>Database</code>。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>具体实现代码，请参考：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fflutter.dusksnow.top%2Fhelp%2Fcore%2Fdatabase.html" target="_blank" title="https://flutter.dusksnow.top/help/core/database.html" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">数据库文档</a></p>
</blockquote>
<h3 data-id="heading-17">7. 本地存储</h3>
<p>基于 shared_preferences 的轻量级本地存储，采用 <strong>DataSource → Repository</strong> 架构，业务层通过 Repository 访问 Token、主题、语言和用户缓存。</p>
<p><strong>使用案例：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-dart" lang="dart"><span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">本地存储示例页 Logic。</span></span>
<span class="hljs-class"><span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title">LocalStorageDemoLogic</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">extends</span> <span class="hljs-title">BaseLogic</span> </span>{
  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">用户信息存储仓库。</span></span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> UserInfoStoreRepository _userInfoStoreRepository =
      UserInfoStoreRepository();

  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">当前用户信息。</span></span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">final</span> Rxn&lt;User&gt; user = Rxn&lt;User&gt;();

  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">保存用户信息。</span></span>
  Future&lt;<span class="hljs-keyword">void</span>&gt; saveUser() <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> User demoUser = User(
      id: <span class="hljs-number">10086</span>,
      nickName: <span class="hljs-string">'演示用户'</span>,
      phone: <span class="hljs-string">'18800000000'</span>,
    );
    <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> _userInfoStoreRepository.saveUserInfo(demoUser);
    user.value = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> _userInfoStoreRepository.getUserInfo();
  }

  <span class="hljs-comment">/// <span class="markdown">清除用户信息。</span></span>
  Future&lt;<span class="hljs-keyword">void</span>&gt; clearUser() <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> _userInfoStoreRepository.clearUserInfo();
    user.value = <span class="hljs-keyword">null</span>;
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p>存储 Key、默认值和 JSON 转换都留在 DataSource 实现中。损坏的用户 JSON 会按无缓存处理，不会把解析异常直接抛给页面。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>具体实现代码，请参考：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fflutter.dusksnow.top%2Fhelp%2Fcore%2Fdatastore.html" target="_blank" title="https://flutter.dusksnow.top/help/core/datastore.html" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">本地存储文档</a></p>
</blockquote>
<h2 data-id="heading-18">工具类</h2>
<p>框架内置了常用工具，避免业务层重复实现：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>ToastUtil</strong>：普通、成功、警告和错误 Toast</li>
<li><strong>AlertUtil</strong>：确认、反馈和业务提示对话框</li>
<li><strong>RouteUtil</strong>：页面跳转、返回、参数读取和导航栈处理</li>
<li><strong>StorageUtil</strong>：SharedPreferences 基础读写</li>
<li><strong>CommonUtil</strong>：复制、震动、平台判断和通用判断</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>具体使用方法，请参考：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fflutter.dusksnow.top%2Fhelp%2Fcore%2Futil.html" target="_blank" title="https://flutter.dusksnow.top/help/core/util.html" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">工具类文档</a></p>
</blockquote>
<h2 data-id="heading-19">项目结构</h2>
<pre><code class="hljs language-text" lang="text">FlutterKit/
├── android / ios / web / ...  # 六端原生工程
├── assets/                     # 图片、图标、主题 JSON 和生成源图
├── docs/                       # FlutterKit 与 TDesign 本地文档
├── lib/
│   ├── bootstrap/              # 启动初始化器
│   ├── core/                   # 核心模块
│   │   ├── base/               # 基础父类
│   │   ├── data/               # Repository 与 Preview Data
│   │   ├── database/           # 数据库
│   │   ├── datastore/          # 本地存储
│   │   ├── design_system/      # 设计系统与链式扩展
│   │   ├── model/              # 数据模型
│   │   ├── network/            # 网络层
│   │   ├── result/             # 结果处理
│   │   ├── service/            # 全局 Service
│   │   └── ui / util / ...     # UI、响应式和工具类
│   ├── feature/                # 功能模块
│   │   ├── auth/               # 认证模块
│   │   ├── demo/               # 示例模块
│   │   ├── main/               # 主模块
│   │   └── user/               # 用户模块
│   ├── routes/                 # 路由、参数、结果和守卫
│   ├── application.dart        # 初始化编排与应用级状态
│   └── main.dart               # Flutter 应用入口
├── test/                       # 单元测试与 Widget 测试
└── tool/                       # 覆盖率检查等脚本
</code></pre>
